long_biography.plain_text:
After trying a dozen daily newspapers, Wanja Oberhof still could not find one that matched his interests. He and Hendrik Tiedemann developed Niiu, allowing readers to combine material from different publications into a personalised printed paper. The print venture closed, but the idea returned as an app, supported by media investors and public research funding.

For the cancer-support organisation yeswecan!cer, Oberhof and Anabel Oelmann helped turn running into fundraising. Alongside Sparda-Bank Berlin, they backed a virtual event in which participants logged their distances, and they ran themselves. The donors later rounded the proceeds up to the campaign’s target.
